newsitem.title: USA: Granite Financial names Frank Corcoran CFO.
newsitem.headline: Granite Financial names Frank Corcoran CFO.

text.p: Granite Financial Inc said on Thursday that it has named Frank Corcoran as its senior vice president and chief financial officer.
Corcoran, formerly of Continental Information Systems Corporation, will assume his new duties on April 28, 1997, Granite said.

William Cobb, current chief financial officer of Granite will become senior vice president of mergers and acquisitions, a newly created position, and will continue to focus on Granite's growth strategy and financing activities.
